description: batch-ordered's file shape with the other outcome: the same header-then-details sequencing and the same pair of discriminators at different offsets and different widths, but with the item covering each run inside the opposing record an unsigned numeric DISPLAY item rather than PIC X. Every byte of such an item is one of the charset's ten digit bytes, so a detail can never carry the header's HDR at bytes ten to twelve and a header can never carry the detail's D at byte zero -- and because that holds in both directions the two tests are exclusive and the descriptor rests on the copybooks rather than on the order. The detail's run is the earlier one, so the state carries the detail's test first, which is the reverse of batch-ordered's order and changes nothing: where the pair is proved exclusive the order at that state cannot be observed at all.
